text:
eli-docs: Pushed a docs PR to update the Kestrel-4B model card with variant support, sequence limits, and a short v2 SDK snippet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1345. Need a quick sweep for numbers and any broken links.

harper-eng: Quick check  the q4 variant is conservative at default max_seq=2048 but we validated 4096 on orion when using the `high-memory` profile. Recommend we state both (default vs profile-enabled) and mark hardware dependency.

zoe-devex: CI shows a broken link to the latency-section anchor (card points to `#latency-ops` but page uses `#latency`).

ci-bot: link-checker: 1 failure  sources/docs/model-catalog/kestrel-4b.md: anchor '#latency-ops' not found.

eli-docs: I'll fix the anchor, add a one-line note: "Default seq limits are conservative; request `profile='high-memory'` to enable extended limits where available." Also will include the v2 snippet using `profile`.

harper-eng: For the snippet use `profile` param and add a commented line showing `kestrel-4b-fp16` for lower-latency option. Keep benchmark mentions as indicative only.

zoe-devex: Add a fallback sentence: if the requested profile isn't available the router may fallback to a compatible variant or region which can increase latency. Customers asked for this clarity.

eli-docs: Added the fallback note and a tiny benchmark footnote: "approx 48 tok/s @seq=1024 batch=1 on orion (q4); extended seq measured at ~22 tok/s @8192 under high-memory." Included disclaimers and a link to the bench dashboard. Fixed anchor and pushed.

ci-bot: pr-check: doc-lint passed, link-checker passed.

zoe-devex: Two micro copy edits  simplified wording and wrapped `high-memory` in code ticks.

harper-eng: LGTM, approved.

eli-docs: Merged. Will watch for any follow-up questions in #support. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
